description: Create a shared group — a reusable bag of secrets (a shared datastore, a vendor account) that many application environments compose in rather than each keeping a copy. Use create_app instead for a deployable service. No key material involved, so it runs here; the group's environments are minted locally by create_group_env. Returns the new { id, orgId, name, slug, createdAt }.

name.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. "Shared Datastores". Can be renamed later.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier the other tools refer to this group by: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (e.g. "shared-datastores"). Immutable once created.

name: create_group
